name: lumen
description: Deterministic, honest SEO audits (20 built-in rules), keyword ideas, rank checks, and CWV page reports — free/BYOK providers only, provenance on every number.

LUMEN_PSI_KEY.title: PageSpeed Insights API key
LUMEN_PSI_KEY.description: Optional — enables the CWV lab leg of page reports. lumen sends this key only to Google's Pagespeed API.

LUMEN_CRUX_KEY.title: Chrome UX Report API key
LUMEN_CRUX_KEY.description: Optional — enables real-user field CWV data. lumen sends this key only to Google's CrUX API.

LUMEN_OPR_KEY.title: Open PageRank API key
LUMEN_OPR_KEY.description: Optional — enables the Open PageRank authority signal. lumen sends this key only to openpagerank.com.
